objective: The streaming parser in apps/local-control/src/agent/model-client.mjs (createModelClient) treats end-of-stream as success, so a dropped connection can release a half-received tool call. Make the stream fail closed: completion requires a finish_reason or a [DONE] sentinel (else ModelRequestError MODEL_STREAM_INTERRUPTED, also when the body ends inside an event); a stream with no non-blank text and no tool call is MODEL_EMPTY_RESPONSE; malformed JSON, error payloads, non-object events, unnamed tool calls and events over 1 MiB are MODEL_INVALID_RESPONSE without echoing provider content. Parse SSE events separated by LF, CRLF or bare CR, join multi-line data: fields, keep split UTF-8 sequences intact, and stop reading at [DONE]. apps/local-control/tests/model-stream.test.mjs must pass.
